input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision in the Agreement, and there is no change-of-control language anywhere (searches for "change of control", "merger" and "successors" return nothing). The clause is mutual and includes an affiliate carve-out, but it fails the fallback on two material terms: (i) there is no successor/M&A carve-out, so any merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of Client's assets requires TrueLink's approval, and (ii) approval is absolute rather than subject to a "not unreasonably withheld" standard, meaning TrueLink could block our corporate transaction outright — this approaches the walk-away case of a consent requirement on Customer assignment with no M&A carve-out. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Client on written notice, applies a reasonableness standard to consent, bars assignment by TrueLink to a Client competitor, and confirms a change of control of Client is not an assignment and gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right, reaching the preferred position with minimal change to the existing sentence.

proposal.summary: Add Client affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard on consent, no competitor assignment by TrueLink, and confirm change of control is not an assignment or termination trigger.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on notice, made consent subject to a reasonableness standard, and confirmed that a change of control of Client does not trigger any TrueLink termination or re-pricing right. Our playbook requires internal reorganizations and M&A to proceed without vendor consent; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, provided that Client gives TrueLink written notice of such assignment. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to any competitor of Client. A change of control of Client shall not constitute an assignment or transfer, and shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
